description: This file contains variable definitions, device configurations, and build procedures for TP-Link devices within an OpenWRT build system. It includes device-specific parameters, image build rules, and firmware packaging scripts for various TP-Link models.

methods.name: Build/tplink-v1-okli-image
methods.description: Builds a TP-Link OKLI image by concatenating kernel and root filesystem, then creating a firmware with mkplinkfw.

methods.name: Build/uImage-tplink-c9
methods.description: Creates a uImage format TP-Link C9 kernel image with specified parameters.

methods.name: Device/tplink-v1
methods.description: Defines device-specific variables and image configurations for TP-Link v1 devices.

methods.name: Device/tplink-v1-okli
methods.description: Extends the tp-link-v1 device with additional loader settings and compilation steps for OKLI variant.

methods.name: Device/tplink-v2
methods.description: Defines device variables and image builds for TP-Link v2 devices.

methods.name: Device/tplink-safeloader
methods.description: Configuration for TP-Link safe loader hardware, with specific images and upgrade procedures.
